RETURN POLICY

Installed items are NOT refundable.
All returns must have original packaging.

Upon receipt of package, it is your responsibility to thoroughly inspect the merchandise within. Stock orders mav be returned within 15 days of purchase. Items must be un-installed (no wires or chain cut)
and in original packaging. Displays can be returned within 15 days in original sold condition. Invoices marked
